observations.behavior: Adds transaction.atomic and database_sync_to_async_pool wrapper to the shared backing-table lookup and creation path.
observations.posthog_connection: This could prevent race conditions where concurrent materialization workflows for the same saved query each attempt to create a new warehouse table instead of sharing one.

observations.behavior: Replaces previous pattern that fetched existing or created separately with an atomic get-or-create helper; also removes redundant save calls after metadata updates.
observations.posthog_connection: Reduces unnecessary DB round-trips and potential duplicate writes when multiple workflows process the same saved query concurrently.

observations.behavior: Adds tests asserting two concurrent workflow invocations share the same DataWarehouseTable and do not increase row count beyond one.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides regression protection against unintended duplication of warehouse tables under concurrency, supporting reliability and cost efficiency.
